note: Incident coordination, response and reporting within cybersecurity risk management.

note: Resource-focused access, explicit authentication/authorization and no implicit network-location trust.

title: Bourtoule et al., Machine Unlearning
note: Primary research illustrating specialized unlearning; not a guarantee for arbitrary deployed models or legal erasure.

title: Wallace et al., The Instruction Hierarchy
note: Primary research on learning instruction priorities; improved robustness does not replace independent authorization.

title: ICO: lawfulness in AI
edition: Checked 20 October 2026; guidance notes ongoing review
note: UK-specific lawful-basis guidance. Do not substitute it for an applicability analysis in another jurisdiction.

title: ICO: engineering individual rights into generative AI
note: A consultation discussing practical rights and unlearning questions, not a universal final compliance rule.

title: EU AI Act Article 25: responsibilities along the value chain
note: Read the high-risk conditions and statutory text. Hosting or adaptation labels alone do not determine role.

title: EU AI Act Article 27: fundamental rights impact assessment
note: Qualifying uses/deployers, exceptions, assessment content and authority notification.

title: European Commission: AI Act implementation
note: Dated application snapshot and links to the adopted amendments; verify transitions and scope.

title: FAIR Institute: loss magnitude and risk factors
note: Frequency/magnitude and primary/secondary-loss structure. Numerical examples here are fictional.

title: Hardt, Price and Srebro: Equality of Opportunity in Supervised Learning
note: Defines equalized odds and its equal-opportunity relaxation; claims of incompatibility need precise conditions.

title: Rudin: use interpretable models for high-stakes decisions
note: Primary research perspective on interpretability and the assumed accuracy trade-off.

title: OWASP LLM01:2025 Prompt Injection
note: Layered mitigations, including filtering, role/context separation, least privilege and approval.

title: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
note: A versioned weakness checklist; distinguish list edition from later project updates.

title: MITRE ATLAS
note: Adversary tactics, techniques and case studies; it evolves rather than having a frozen exam edition.

title: ISO/IEC 42001 AI management systems
note: Public catalogue/description used for overview. This book does not reproduce or claim a full clause-by-clause review of the paid standard.

title: ISO/IEC 5338 AI system lifecycle processes
note: Public catalogue reference; lifecycle gate examples here are author-created teaching aids.

title: ISO/IEC 42005 AI system impact assessment
note: Public description of impact-assessment guidance; avoid treating it as legislation.

title: US agencies: Interagency Guidance on Third-Party Relationships
note: Primary example of direct third-party and subcontractor relationships, evidence and lifecycle responsibilities; sector scope matters.

title: Zillow Q3 2021 shareholder letter
note: Company account of forecasting uncertainty and the Offers wind-down; does not prove a single isolated technical cause.

title: OpenAI: March 20 ChatGPT outage report
note: Provider's historical incident account; its sequence is not a universal notification rule.

title: New York DFS: Apple Card investigation report
note: Regulator report distinguishing allegations, findings and communication concerns.

title: Cohen et al.: Here Comes the AI Worm
note: Morris II laboratory proof of concept, not a report of a production outbreak.

title: PyTorch: compromised nightly dependency
note: Primary incident account of the torchtriton dependency-confusion event.

title: JFrog security research discoveries in 2024
note: Researcher account of malicious model artifacts; scanning has defined scope and limitations.

title: Dutch DPA: discriminatory Tax Administration processing
note: Historical enforcement announcement about nationality data; the broader scandal had multiple institutional and legal causes.

title: Moffatt v. Air Canada, 2024 BCCRT 149
note: Read the actual jurisdiction-specific decision rather than assuming every chatbot statement creates a binding contract.

title: Italian DPA: ChatGPT processing restriction
note: Historical regulatory action; later proceedings or appeals should not be inferred from this snapshot.

title: Slack privacy principles: data management
note: Assess current actual terms and product scope; historical controversy is not a claim of current training practice.

title: Zoom: terms of service and AI practices
note: Provider clarification; current contracting must use current applicable terms.

title: Microsoft MSRC: CVE-2025-32711
note: Vulnerability evidence is distinct from proof of a production exploitation event or a specific local ACL failure.

title: UNODC: cyber-enabled fraud and deepfake case
note: Corroborates the reported Arup event; use it as a historical illustration, not proof no detection control could work.

title: Bloomberg: Samsung restriction after sensitive-code upload
edition: 2 May 2023 original reporting; may be paywalled
note: Historical reporting, not a statement of Samsung's current policy.

title: Reuters: Amazon's experimental recruiting tool
note: Reported experimental-system issues; do not infer that every internal use or downstream decision was independently assessed here.

title: TIME: DPD chatbot incident and company response
note: Historical report of manipulated output and company response; a case illustration, not proof of every internal detection control.

title: ICO: Clearview AI enforcement announcement
note: Historical enforcement statement. Appeals and jurisdictional outcomes require current legal verification; this is not a final-status claim.

title: ISO/IEC 23894 AI risk-management guidance
note: Public catalogue description, not a reproduced or exhaustive clause review.
